entries.title: Immigration: conditional legal status
entries.question_text_2024: Grant legal status to all illegal immigrants who have held jobs and paid taxes for at least 3 years, and not been convicted of any felony crimes
entries.harmonization: Legalization is the liberal endpoint; historical checkbox forms require separate comparability review.

entries.title: Immigration: border patrols
entries.question_text_2024: Increase the number of border patrols on the US-Mexican border
entries.harmonization: Increased immigration enforcement is the conservative endpoint; historical checkbox forms require separate review.

entries.title: Immigration: border wall
entries.question_text_2024: Build a wall between the U.S. and Mexico
entries.harmonization: Border-wall support is the conservative endpoint. Distinct from historical bundled border-spending-and-wall question.

entries.title: Immigration: Dreamers legal status
entries.question_text_2024: Provide permanent resident status to children of immigrants who were brought to the United States by their parents (also known as Dreamers). Provide these immigrants a pathway to citizenship if they meet the citizenship requirements and have committed no crimes
entries.harmonization: Legal status and pathway to citizenship are the liberal endpoint.

entries.title: Environment: carbon emissions regulation
entries.question_text_2024: Give the Environmental Protection Agency power to regulate carbon dioxide emissions
entries.harmonization: Support for carbon-emission regulation is the liberal endpoint.

entries.title: Environment: renewable electricity
entries.question_text_2024: Require that at least 20 percent of electricity be generated with renewable sources such as wind, solar, or hydroelectric power
entries.harmonization: Support for renewable-energy mandates is the liberal endpoint.

entries.title: Environment: clean air and water enforcement
entries.question_text_2024: Strengthen the Environmental Protection Agency enforcement of the Clean Air Act and Clean Water Act even if it costs U.S. jobs
entries.harmonization: Support for environmental enforcement despite the stated employment tradeoff is the liberal endpoint; retain tradeoff wording.

entries.title: Environment: fossil fuel production
entries.question_text_2024: Increase fossil fuel production in the U.S.
entries.harmonization: Support for expanded fossil-fuel production is the conservative endpoint.

entries.title: Environment: oil and gas leases
entries.question_text_2024: Halt new oil and gas leases on federal lands
entries.harmonization: Support for restricting fossil-fuel leases is the liberal endpoint.

entries.title: Health care: Medicaid work requirements
entries.question_text_2024: Require able-bodied adults under 64 years of age who do not have dependents to have a job in order to receive Medicaid.
entries.harmonization: Support for work requirements restricting Medicaid eligibility is the conservative endpoint.

entries.title: Health care: Affordable Care Act
entries.harmonization: Same repeal proposal as the existing item; opposition is the liberal endpoint.

entries.title: Health care: Medicaid expansion
entries.question_text_2024: Expand Medicaid to cover individuals making less than $25,000 and families making less than $40,000 a year.
entries.harmonization: Support for expanded public health coverage at the specified thresholds is the liberal endpoint.
